comments.text: Turn off Auto if game is stuttering because it aggressively scans all remotes and functions every so often, I mean any that are present in the game. I've never had any success with firing remotes so maybe my code was off or something maybe you guys can experiment. The new version doesn't have direct copying but it allows you to add it to be able to fire/test, it may not work in this script but may work in yours, you can see the address of the remote/function to the right under the name of the desired remote/function.
